50 Gifts For University Students
50 Gifts For University Students
Culture & Trends
Lydia Kah-Pavlou
23 July 2026
16 min read

Need gift ideas for a uni student in your life? We've got every budget covered.

Celebrate your student pals by gifting them something to help with their new chapter. Whether they're just starting out or heading into their second or third year, the right gift can make a real difference — practically or emotionally.

Students at university often need household, kitchen, and everyday items they haven't thought about yet. Below are 50 gifts for uni students at every budget — things they'll actually use and genuinely appreciate.

In this guide:

Gifts For University Students
1. Desk Lamp

A desk lamp is the gift every uni student needs but won't think to buy until they're squinting through a 3am essay. Most halls have terrible overhead lighting, and a dimmable desk lamp gives them the option to switch between focused study mode and low-key ambient vibes. It'll also do wonders for those dreary beige walls.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

2. Amazon Prime

Students rely on Amazon Prime more than they'd like to admit — next-day delivery on everything from textbooks to kitchen essentials, plus exclusive student pricing. Get them signed up and they'll thank you every time a parcel arrives.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

3. Amazon Echo

An Amazon Echo pulls its weight in a student flat. From setting reminders and playing music to answering random trivia questions during procrastination sessions, Alexa has a lot to offer. Great speaker, surprisingly useful assistant.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

4. Spotify Subscription

Nothing kills a pre-drinks playlist like an ad break. A Spotify subscription gives them ad-free listening for studying, commuting, and everything in between — and it's one less monthly expense to worry about.

Spotify student discount available via Student Beans

5. Photo Frames

A simple, heartfelt gift. A photo frame with a picture of the two of you means they'll have a reminder of home when uni gets overwhelming. Oliver Bonas has some lovely options, and students get 10% off.

Get a 10% student discount at Oliver Bonas

6. Apple MacBook

For higher budgets, a MacBook is genuinely one of the most useful things a student can have — especially with so much of uni life happening online. Apple offers student discounts, and Currys does too. If a MacBook is too much of a stretch, check out the best laptops under £300 instead.

Get a student discount at Currys

7. Alarm Clock

A physical alarm clock is underrated. It gets the phone off the bedside table, reduces screen time before bed, and (ideally) gets them to their 9am. The ones that project the time onto the ceiling are particularly hard to ignore.

8. Fitbit / Smartwatch

A Fitbit or smartwatch is a surprisingly motivating gift for a student who wants to be more active but needs a nudge. Steps, sleep tracking, workouts — it does it all, and students get 20% off via Student Beans.

Get a 20% Fitbit student discount via Student Beans

9. Planner

Uni life is a juggling act. A good planner helps them keep track of deadlines, social plans, and (hopefully) visits home to see you. Papier does beautiful ones with student discounts.

Get a student discount at Papier

10. Dinner Set

Practical gifts for uni students never miss. A proper dinner set — plates, bowls, mugs — means they won't be eating pasta off a single plate they found in the cupboard. Get a colourful set from Amazon that'll brighten up any student kitchen.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

11. Bath Mat

Unglamorous but essential. Shared uni bathrooms can be grim, and a cheerful bath mat makes the whole experience more bearable and safer. Oliver Bonas has some lovely options.

Get a student discount at Oliver Bonas

12. LED Lights

LED strip lights are a student room staple. They're cheap, easy to put up, and transform the vibe of even the most depressing hall. Great for ambience, less ideal for revision.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

13. Bottle Opener

One of the three things students consistently forget to pack (alongside scissors and a tin opener). A bottle opener will be used constantly and always appreciated.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

14. Mugs

You can never have too many mugs. Communal kitchen hang-outs run on tea and gossip — a cute mug is a small thing that gets used every single day. Typo has a great range with student discounts.

Get a student discount at Typo

15. Highlighters

The unsung heroes of the pencil case. A bumper set of highlighters will last through multiple years of lectures and revision sessions, and make notes look far more satisfying than they have any right to.

Get a student discount at Typo

16. Tea Towels

Nobody thinks to bring tea towels to uni. Gifting a set means they won't be drying their hands on a hoodie or, worse, sharing one manky communal tea towel with six flatmates.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

17. Sliders

Student halls floors are... a lot. A decent pair of sliders or slippers keeps feet off suspicious surfaces and is genuinely one of the more appreciated practical gifts.

Get a student discount at ASOS

18. Dressing Gown

Student housing gets cold. A good dressing gown is cosy, practical, and will get used every single day through winter. Bonus: it doubles as an outfit for kitchen runs at 2am.

19. Blender

Smoothies, protein shakes, soups — a blender is far more useful than students expect. Once they discover they can make a soup by blending whatever vegetables are left at the end of the week, they'll never look back.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

20. Kindle

Uni textbooks are expensive; Kindle versions are usually cheaper and available instantly. A Kindle also makes it easier to actually read for pleasure, which is something students often stop doing the moment they start a literature degree.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

21. Laptop Case

Students carry their laptops through rain, crowded buses, and chaotic library scrambles. A proper case protects against spills and scratches and is significantly cheaper than a laptop repair. Skinnydip has some great ones.

Get a student discount at Skinnydip

22. Toastie Maker

A student kitchen essential. Toasties are quick, customisable, and endlessly satisfying. This might be the gift that makes you their favourite person.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

23. Desk Mirror

For students sharing a bathroom who want to get ready without the morning queue, a desk mirror is a quiet game-changer.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

24. AirPods

Wire-free listening for the gym, the library, and the commute between them. AirPods are a premium gift but a genuinely excellent one — Apple offers student discounts to soften the cost.

Get a student discount at Apple

25. Water Bottle

A reusable water bottle is one of the most practical gifts going. Most campuses have refill stations, and a decent insulated bottle keeps water cold and coffee hot all day. It also saves money on campus drinks.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

26. Wireless Charger

Wireless charging is one of those things that feels like a small upgrade but makes daily life noticeably better. No cables to untangle, no hunting for the right plug — just put the phone down and it charges.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

27. Backpack

A sturdy backpack for carrying a laptop, textbooks, and everything else across campus is something every student needs but might not have thought to replace. Worth investing in a good one.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

28. Laundry Basket

Laundry is the chore students are most likely to avoid for the longest time. A laundry basket at least contains the chaos.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

29. Cushions

Halls are sparse. A few cushions go a long way toward making a room feel like an actual home rather than a budget hotel.

Get a student discount at Oliver Bonas

30. Blankets

A fluffy throw makes any uni room feel cosier and comes into its own during winter when the heating is questionable. Great for film nights in the communal kitchen too.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

31. Headspace Subscription

Starting university is exciting but also genuinely stressful. Headspace uses science-backed meditation and mindfulness tools to help with sleep, anxiety, and daily overwhelm. A really thoughtful gift for someone navigating a big life change.

Headspace student discount available via Student Beans

32. Rug

A small rug by the desk or beside the bed makes a hall room feel instantly more put together. It doesn't need to be big — even a small rectangle of texture helps the space feel lived-in.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

33. Travel Mug

Getting to a 9am without coffee is inadvisable. A travel mug keeps drinks hot for hours, is more environmentally friendly than disposable cups, and often gets you a discount at coffee shops too.

34. Notepad

Students will always need notepads — for lectures, revision, and scribbling down everything that pops into their head during an essay. A nice notepad from Papier makes the whole experience feel more considered.

Get a student discount at Papier

35. Overnight Bag

If you're going to miss them, make it easy for them to come home. A practical overnight bag from ASOS (student discount available) means weekend trips back are much less of a faff.

Get a student discount at ASOS

36. Food Storage Boxes

Buying lunch on campus every day adds up fast. Food storage boxes mean they can meal-prep the night before and bring something decent in — saving money and eating better at the same time.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

37. Reusable Straws

A small but genuinely useful gift now that paper straws are everywhere. Reusable straws can be kept in a bag and brought out whenever needed. Better for the environment and for the experience of finishing a drink before the straw gives up.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

38. Starbucks Gift Card

Coffee is a student essential. A Starbucks gift card takes a little pressure off the weekly budget and gives them something to look forward to on the way to a lecture.

39. Reed Diffuser

Most halls ban candles, but that doesn't mean rooms have to smell like last night's pasta. A reed diffuser is the approved alternative — subtle, long-lasting, and much better for communal spaces.

40. Pencil Case

Every student either has every pen they've ever owned or none at all. A pencil case (with a decent selection of pens) is a small gift that solves a genuinely consistent problem.

41. Coffee Table Books

A well-chosen coffee table book can make a uni room feel more like a home and gives them something interesting to pull out when people come over. Pick something that reflects their interests — photography, design, sport, fashion — and it becomes a personal rather than generic gift.

42. Hoover

Unglamorous but essential. Some halls provide one for shared use, but a compact personal hoover is a gift that'll get genuinely used — and taken into post-uni life too.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

43. Polaroid Camera

First year is full of moments worth capturing. A Polaroid camera produces photos that feel more permanent than a phone camera roll, and the prints look great on a bedroom wall.

44. Bedside Table

Uni rooms are often sparse on storage. A small bedside table — somewhere for a lamp, a phone, a glass of water — makes the space feel more complete and functional.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

45. Wall Tapestry

A tapestry is one of the quickest ways to make a hall room feel less like a cell. Pick one that suits their style and pair it with command strips so nothing gets damaged.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

46. Wireless Printer

Library printing costs add up, and the queue at 9am before a deadline is horrific. A wireless printer in their room solves both problems, and makes them immediately popular with every flatmate.

Get a student discount at HP

47. Jewellery Storage

For the student with a lot of jewellery and nowhere organised to keep it. Oliver Bonas has beautiful options that look good on display too.

Get a student discount at Oliver Bonas

48. Pizza Cutter

Students eat a lot of pizza. That's not a criticism, it's just true. Frozen pizza is cheap and quick, and a pizza cutter makes it significantly easier to eat.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

49. Wine Glasses

Students who drink wine rarely own actual wine glasses. These from Oliver Bonas are decent quality, look good, and are the kind of thoughtful touch that makes a student feel like a proper adult (at least briefly).

50. Hard Drive

Three years of essays, projects, presentations, and downloaded lecture slides takes up a lot of storage. A hard drive means they won't be frantically deleting photos the night before a deadline to free up space.

Get a student discount at Amazon Prime

Gift Ideas For Neurodivergent Students

Show you've thought about what will actually help them at uni:

Weighted blanket — can ease anxiety and help with sleep

Noise-cancelling headphones — invaluable for anyone sensitive to noise or needing to focus in busy spaces

Fidget tools — helpful for managing restlessness during long study sessions

Loop earplugs — a more discreet option for managing sensory input in lectures, social situations, or everyday environments (get 16% off with a Loop Earplugs student discount).

FAQs

What gifts to buy for uni students?

Practical gifts are almost always the right call — things they need but haven't thought to get. Kitchen essentials, room décor, tech accessories, and subscriptions are all solid choices. If you want something more personal, a piece of jewellery or a photo gift shows real thought.

What to write in a moving-to-uni card?

Be as heartfelt as you want — going to university is a genuinely big deal. Keep it warm, encourage them, and maybe promise to visit.

Are candles allowed in uni halls?

Usually no. Most student accommodation bans candles and incense due to fire risk. A reed diffuser is the approved alternative and makes an equally nice gift.
